correctness.rationale: The helper documents and implements the inspectable poll-loop structure—PR arg validation, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list load with [bot] stripping, pre/post head SHA comparison, unresolved-thread and non-terminal-review jq filters, and RESULT=/HEAD= emission for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR paths. Six-point deduction for material contract gaps: the GraphQL call passes literal -F owner=:owner -F repo=:repo placeholders instead of resolved repository coordinates, so live gh calls would fail or target the wrong repository; inline comments admit bot reviews are not filtered to the current head SHA despite the task requiring participating bots be terminal for the current head; and CONVERGED can fire when reviewThreads and reviews are both empty without establishing that expected bots have finished on HEAD.

quality.rationale: Core shell deliverables are readable and mostly repo-shaped: logging.sh sourcing, documented exit contract header, canonical bot-allowlist.txt, and a well-written pr-resolve-all.md settle-window section that prefers the helper while preserving the 360-second fallback. Deductions for AI_REPO_GUIDE.md footer corruption (duplicate '-facing behavior changes' fragment), corrupt unrelated edits to docs/compliance_schemas.md (duplicate agents_md_version lines and role substitutions), a compliance_schema.py receipt-key change that no longer matches the updated fixtures, a committed IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md artifact, and a thin scripts/checks/055-pr-poll-helper.sh that only existence-checks files instead of following the repo's run_bats_check wiring pattern used by peer poll checks.

process.rationale: Required prompt and guide companions are touched and pr-resolve-all.md correctly prefers the helper with a documented time-based fallback, and the implementation plan block cites doc-sync triggers. Two-point deduction for noticeable scope drift: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md committed as a stray plan artifact, unrelated compliance_schema.py and v19-to-v20 fixture churn flagged by objective scope:compliance_fixtures warn, and corrupted companion-doc edits beyond the settle-window task; objective process scored 12/15 and test_wiring only 1/2 patterns matched.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is partial but credible: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats stubs gh and asserts CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, and SHA_CHANGED exit codes with matching RESULT tokens; objective bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed. Two-point deduction: no bats case for API_ERROR (missing PR arg is implemented but untested; gh/auth/graphql failures untested), all GraphQL fixtures use empty reviewThreads so unresolved bot-thread and allow-list matching logic is unexercised, scripts/checks/055-pr-poll-helper.sh never invokes run_bats_check, and objective bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped so runtime pass is unconfirmed in this bundle.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability assumes the four stub-based bats cases are structurally sound but not runtime-verified in this bundle.

citations.claim: hard_gate_pass is true, enabling normal subjective scoring rather than fail-closed zeroing.
